title: Stabilize Company B queue recovery before integration
objective: Correct the post-PASS publication recovery contract in the new Company B queue worker before it is integrated into the operational branch. Preserve fail-closed blocked labeling while making a bounded rerun able to resume only a previously validated PASS/DONE worker result. Also make the normal queue base default to the Company B operational branch rather than the bootstrap branch.
acceptance_criteria: A publication failure may remain visibly company-b:blocked, but a later invocation must be able to identify and resume that blocked Issue only when its local queue state exists and the authoritative worker state validates as the same task/branch with status PASS, phase DONE, and reviewVerdict PASS.
Blocked Issues whose worker state is absent, malformed, non-PASS, or does not match the saved queue state must never be auto-resumed.
Recovery must never re-invoke Claude implementation or Codex review after a validated PASS/DONE worker result; it may only retry remote branch/PR/evidence/lifecycle publication.
Queued tasks with an existing task runtime must still fail closed rather than being treated as recovery.
The default BaseRef for the production queue wrapper must be company-b/operational-v0.1, not company-b/bootstrap-claude-led-v0.1.
Update QUEUE_PROTOCOL.md so its recovery description exactly matches executable behavior.
Extend deterministic queue contract tests to cover blocked publication recovery, rejection of non-PASS blocked runtimes, no worker reinvocation on recovery, and the operational default BaseRef.
Do not broaden scope into scheduler/heartbeat yet.
Existing pytest suite plus the updated queue contract tests must pass.
Final independent Codex review must return PASS.
